items.title: [Team J] Chapter 7: The Truth Exposed
items.text:
[Team J] Chapter 7: The Truth Exposed
After spending some time in the Library of the Royal Arcane Academy, Anbel felt like they needed to get a move on, especially since now enemies were bound to know that they were here already. Anbel gathered everyone. “We need to get a move onto Patricia Holbor, before she knows we’re here and runs, potentially trapping us in the halls here.” He said, grabbing his own gear. “I don’t care if any of you grab as many books as you can, but don’t let them slow you down.” He said, stuffing a book into his sleeve that detailed information about the Strairus Royal Family. Dirk sighed. “Just don’t go about dumping yer books onto me or the crew, you got that?” He said sternly.

---

It didn’t take long before they began to venture out towards the academy itself. Those who knew the school took charge of leading everyone to where Patricia might be at. The halls were long, winding, and even changing as everyone was walking through, no doubt by the influence of magic in the area. This made it harder than it needed to be in order to navigate. However, as everyone was walking, they heard a voice in the distance. “Like moths to the flame, the moths will burn…” A faint voice heard. It did echo through the halls, and Anbel sighed. “I see she taunts us now. The voice might be where she’s at. It’s all we have to go off of.” He said. 

After following the voice as it taunted everyone with phrases like: “The herd of sheep will die to a few wolves.” “Herd mentality will do you no good.” “Why put trust in a man who keeps his history from you?” “What do you hope to accomplish by charging into my halls?” “The hand that once fed three of you will strangle you three.” As everyone walked down the halls where it was coming from, it was getting louder. Until everyone was met with soldiers who popped in out of nowhere. Some of them were wearing academy uniforms, some wearing Norforian armor. A women on a horse and a man in thick, black armor walked in. “And here are the livestock, ready to be slaughtered.” She said. 

---

Anbel glared at her. “Patricia Holbor. Why did you betray your country ten years ago? What could Renault offer that you didn’t have?” He asked. Patricia smirked. “Easy: A way to kill the Havern family. You fail to realize that they bullied all of us a decade ago. They used their military might and their prestige to force us all to do what they wanted us to do. Surely you know about what your father did, right, dear Prince Liam Klein Havern?” She asked him, waving her finger at him tauntingly. Anbel sighed. “Like Waylon, you go on about something you know nothing about.” He said. Patricia grinned. “What makes you think I’m lying? After all, I taught you some private lessons myself, under orders of your dear father, King Klein Havern. Surely you should know that I know more about you than Waylon ever did. I enchanted that royal weapon you carry, the Orenmir. I remember seeing you get so happy when I did so, to the point you never let it go from your hands or sight. I know that you yearned to become king like your father did. Too bad you’ll never get the chance now.” She said.

Anbel moved to pull out Orenmir and slash her with it, but she waved her hand and it moved on its own, falling to the ground. Anbel tried to stand, but then green electricity shot up the blade, electrocuting him. He screamed in pain as he fell to the ground. “I said I enchanted that weapon, and I left it open for me to do that in case you ever got out of line, Liam. Why do you still hope you can restore the world? Greed? Glory? Wanting to rule the continent under an iron fist like your father? Please, that era of the land died a decade ago, just like your father did when I burned him alive. I remember hearing him beg for mercy as his skin became black. It was music to my ears-“ She said before she saw that Anbel was getting up. “You think you can beat the woman who taught you everything you know about myself? You fail to remember that a lot changes in a decade-“ 

---

She said before a shuriken found itself planted in her hand. “SHUT UP! SHUT UP YOU STUPID BITCH! What give you the right to talk about my father and my family legacy like that!? You don’t know anything about me! I will regain my right to the Strairus throne, and I will begin by making sure you don’t live to see that day! I changed in that decade too! I learned about what Renault has done, and continues to do, and I WILL NOT FAIL!” He shouted at her.

Patricia cooed at him. “Oh, now you reveal the truth to your companions! Too bad it’s too late! Clyde, grab that blade! It’ll be a nice gift to the King.” She said. Clyde began to move to the blade, but Roja came in with her axe, slashing at his armor with enough force to knock him back towards Patricia. “You will not be victorious over us today. We have quality soldiers fighting for us, while you use magic to fake them. You’re not the woman I heard about ten years ago. You’re a husk: A monster like Renault.” She said coldly, giving Orenmir back to Anbel. Patricia growled. “You stupid bimbo! It’s too late to get your world back!” She shouted, warping Clyde and herself back to her throne room. She casted a magic barrier over it. Anbel was seething with anger. “Charge! Don’t let her live to have one more breath!” He shouted.

Patricia went back to grinning. "Oh, in due time, you'll find that my magic is to be feared. You all will end up dying to my magic soon enough, starting now." She said to herself, waving her hand as a purple mist fell over the entire area.

---

Map: https://imgur.com/743eTT8

Terrain Map: https://imgur.com/t9gS7Tv

Objective: Kill Patricia

Win condition: Kill Patricia and Clyde

Side Objectives: Kill as many enemies as you can.

Lose conditions: 20 turns pass or everyone falls.

Notes:

Patricia is protected by a magic barrier. Nothing can pass it. In order to get rid of it, the three panels (weird blocks) in the middle section of rooms each must be interacted with in order to shut them off. Each one turns off one piece of the barrier, corresponding to where the rooms line up with the barrier.

The brown tiles are portals. This time, instead of respawning enemies, they can be used by the players in order to move into any of the other rooms of their choice. If you still have movement after you go through them, then you can use your remaining move once you get out.

BTW, Anbel replaced his Kodachi with an Iron Shuriken.
